operation.title: Wire _witness() into the E3 observation ledger
operation.phase: E3 candidate detection, adjudication, and ingestion
operation.intent: Make witnessed in-session runtime events observable to E3 without granting _witness() any new epistemic authority.
operation.authority_principle: Detection may observe. Detection may propose. Detection may never confer E3.

deltas.framing: The original baseline is preserved as a Git object and tag. This branch contains an explicitly declared delta from that baseline. The manifest proof/evidence/SELF-INTEGRITY-VERIFIED.sha256 describes the tree at 1f246be and nothing else; on this branch it correctly reports the modified files below as changed.

modified.reason: Wire persisted WITNESS events into the E3 observation ledger.
specifics: Observation / ObservationLedger / record_observation relocated here from kernel/e3.py — where an event was witnessed is a runtime fact; the core must not depend on the extension.
Store.ledger added and included in Store.transaction() snapshot.
Journey.conversation_id added so ledger entries are built from authoritative Journey state.
_witness() mints a runtime-owned turn_id and appends one ledger record per persisted episode.
INTERNAL_FAULT added to ENVELOPE_CODES; invoke() now catches unexpected exceptions.

modified.reason: INTERNAL_FAULT added to the failure_code enum. A failure code outside the published contract is itself a contract breach, so emitting it required declaring it.
Suite registration and E3_DONE_CONDITIONS. The eleven sealed reopening conditions and self_integrity() are untouched.

schema_change_to_sealed_table.statement: alter table cc.episodes add column if not exists session_id uuid;
schema_change_to_sealed_table.rationale: E3 is first-hand observation and 'first-hand' is only meaningful within a session. cc.episodes carried conversation_id and selfnode_id but not session_id, so the same-session requirement could only have been checked against the candidate's own claim about itself — exactly the provenance a candidate must not be trusted to supply.
schema_change_to_sealed_table.safety: Additive, in a new migration, nullable. Pre-existing episodes get NULL, and `is distinct from` treats NULL as a mismatch, so they cannot support an E3 candidate. Correct failure direction.

extension_invariant.statement: For a WITNESS invocation eligible for observation recording, persistence of the canonical episode and its observation-ledger entry is atomic.
extension_invariant.note: E3-WIRE-005 forces failure after episode insertion and before ledger completion — the same seam where the earlier shadow-copy bug lived. Held on the same footing as INV-CC-REVELATION-CEILING.

authority_audit.question: Did this delta merely make witnessed runtime events observable to E3, or did it accidentally give _witness() new epistemic authority?
authority_audit.method: Line-level diff of kernel/journey.py against tag self-integrity-verified-v0.1.
authority_audit.e3_mentions_in_delta: Two lines of docstring prose describing why the ledger outranks a candidate's self-declared provenance. No code path.
behavioural_evidence: E3-WIRE-008: ledger insertion creates no evidence edge and no standing
E3-WIRE-008a: the Observation record has no behaviour/meaning/evidence-class/standing field
E3-WIRE-008b: WITNESS emits no E3 candidate and names none in its mutations
E3-WIRE-003: a payload naming its own selfnode/session/conversation/source is ignored in favour of Journey state
authority_audit.verdict: Observable only. No new epistemic authority conferred on _witness(). Submitted for human review; not self-certified.

findings.finding: The prior chat handoff stated source commit 2a55d0c. The actual commit is 72070ab59b8bd654899863bed71845d4fc29c33d. No command had produced 2a55d0c; it was asserted, not read.
findings.disposition: Corrected in this record. 72070ab is authoritative. This is the reason reconciliation against actual repository state precedes transmission.

findings.finding: An unexpected exception inside a primitive handler escaped invoke() entirely, returning no Response to the caller. State rollback was already correct; the envelope was not.
findings.disposition: invoke() now catches broadly and returns INTERNAL_FAULT, declared in ENVELOPE_CODES and in contract/self-journey.v0.1.schema.json.

findings.finding: Observation/ObservationLedger were defined in kernel/e3.py, which would have made the authority core import the extension — the wrong dependency direction.
findings.disposition: Relocated to kernel/journey.py; kernel/e3.py now consumes them.

findings.finding: proof/test_baseline_integrity.py refused to pass three times during this operation, each time correctly. Twice the declaration parser failed to recognise the format used in BASELINE-DELTA.md (### headings; multiple backticked paths on one line); once a genuinely undeclared modification (proof/run_all.py) was present.
findings.disposition: Parser now collects every backticked path on any declaration line and counts only paths that exist on disk, so prose cannot accidentally authorise a change. No check was weakened.
